chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
There is no problem with the exclusive Umrah during the months of Hajj. Then he returns to his family, if he wills.

key_terms.أَشْهُرِ الْحَجِّ: Months of Hajj (Dhu al-Qi'dah, Dhu al-Hijjah, and the first ten days of Muharram)
key_terms.الْعُمْرَةِ الْمُفْرَدَةِ: Exclusive Umrah (Umrah performed independently, not combined with Hajj)
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: There is no problem / It is permissible

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on performing Umrah separately from Hajj during the months of Hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the permissibility of performing Umrat al-Mufradah (independent Umrah) separately from Hajj during the sacred months, allowing the pilgrim to return home after completing the Umrah rites. This ruling highlights the flexibility in Shia jurisprudence regarding the timing and combination of pilgrimage acts, distinguishing it from the mandatory Hajj al-Tamattu'. The narration underscores that while combining them is common, performing them exclusively is equally valid and does not incur any religious penalty.

en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘There is no problem with the exclusive Umra during the months of Hajj. Then he returns to him family, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Willing’.
en.sarwar: 2. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla’ ibn Muhammad, from al-Hassan ibn Ali, from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
It is not harmful to perform al-‘Umrah al-Mufradah in the months of al-Hajj and thereafter to return to one’s family, if one so desires.’”
